steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Plate tectonics states the lithosphere is divided into large plates that move on the asthenosphere, driven by convection currents in the mantle | Key Fact: Divergent boundaries: plates move apart (e.g. Mid-Atlantic Ridge), creating new oceanic crust | Key Fact: Convergent boundaries: plates collide; oceanic-continental produces subduction zones and volcanoes; continental-continental produces fold mountains | Key Fact: Transform boundaries: plates slide past each other (e.g. San Andreas Fault), causing earthquakes

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from plate tectonics theory, and one past-paper question.
